data.name: Kashyap
data.gender_notes: Kashyap is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Kashyap is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Kas’ meaning ‘river’ and ‘Yap’ meaning ‘god’. In Hindu mythology, Kashyap is the name of several gods and sages, most notably the creator of the universe and the father of all the gods – Lord Brahma. The name is also associated with the god of learning and knowledge, Lord Ganesha.

It is also a popular name among Hindu families and individuals, reflecting a deep connection to the rich heritage and mythology of Hinduism. It is believed that individuals bearing the name are endowed with divine blessings and the ability to create or nurture new beginnings. The name is also associated with Lord Ganesha, the elephant-headed god of wisdom, knowledge, and prosperity, encouraging individuals to seek knowledge, wisdom, and spiritual growth throughout their lives.
